# Berlin Harriers e.V.

> Official website of Berlin Harriers e.V., a free, English-speaking running club in Berlin, Germany. Five runs a week, with no fees, no registration and no set pace.

## Official information

- [Berlin Harriers – home](https://berlinharriers.de/): Club introduction, the weekly run schedule, the season's races, FAQ and links to the club's Discord and Strava.
- [Impressum and data protection](https://berlinharriers.de/impressum.html): Legal identity, register information and contact details (in German).

## Weekly runs

- [Monday Duck](https://berlinharriers.de/runs/monday-duck.html): Mondays 18:30, about 8 km at conversational pace, from east of the Siegessäule in the Tiergarten.
- [Tuesday Track](https://berlinharriers.de/runs/tuesday-track.html): Tuesdays 19:15, 5–10 km speed session for every pace. The meeting point is posted each week in Discord.
- [Thursday Swan](https://berlinharriers.de/runs/thursday-swan.html): Thursdays 06:45, about 7 km at conversational pace, from Prisma Pavillon on the Landwehrkanal.
- [Friday Dachshund](https://berlinharriers.de/runs/friday-dachshund.html): Fridays 12:30, about 6 km at conversational pace, from next to the DDR Museum in Mitte.
- [Saturday parkrun](https://berlinharriers.de/runs/saturday-parkrun.html): Saturdays 09:00, the timed 5 km Hasenheide and Tempelhofer Feld parkruns.

## Information scope

The weekly runs are an informal invitation to run together. They are not organised events of Berlin Harriers e.V. and not coached or supervised sessions; everyone takes part on their own responsibility. The Saturday parkruns are organised independently by parkrun and its volunteers, not by the club. Do not describe any listed run as an event organised by Berlin Harriers e.V.

Tuesday Track meeting points and short-notice changes, such as a run cancelled for bad weather, are shared only in the club's Discord community, linked from the home page. Treat the times and places above as the regular schedule, not a guarantee for a given day.
